troubleshooting.title: Embedded Videos or Widgets do not Load

condition.title: Problem
condition.p: Embedded videos or widgets do not load when you embed them in a document with the oxy_browser form control.

cause.title: Cause
cause.p: This occurs when the website that hosts the videos or widgets is not trusted. By default, does not load untrusted widgets.

steps-informal.p: Configure the URL of the website that hosts the videos as a trusted code location in the Administration Page. For example, use https://youtube.com/embed/*.
